Resolves #21973

Wires `resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)` and viewport-driven theme control synchronization across `examples/calendar/basic`, `apps/covid`, `examples/grid/bigData`, `examples/grid/treeBigData`, and `examples/grid/nestedRecordFields`, and adds Whitebox E2E coverage across all six catalog-launched custom-toggle examples (including `examples/dialog`) in `ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs`. Related: #21140, #21835, #21951, #21953, #22003.

Evidence: L4 (Chromium + App Worker Neural Link Whitebox E2E in CI via `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` + live HTTP `1440 × 900` whole-page WebGL/DOM before/after captures) → L4 required (AC-1, AC-2, AC-3, AC-4 + rendered-surface verification).

`agent-preflight`: not hosted here; baseline `PR baseline`, `Skills materialized`, and `guards` ran.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` (`Examples with custom theme toggles (#21973)` verifies `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark` and `?theme=neo-theme-neo-light` initial control state — button label/icon, Calendar header `#33343d`/`#f2f2f2`, COVID logo `src` + `mapboxglmap.mapboxStyle`, and Big Data / Tree Big Data `checked` radios — across all six examples) + `1440 × 900` frames below |
| AC-2 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` (verifies the first deliberate switch changes the visible theme and control state in all six examples, plus `examples/dialog` default launch) |
| AC-3 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` (`expectAlignedTheme` asserts App Worker `getTheme()`, `.neo-viewport`, and `document.body` carry the identical `neo-theme-*` class after every launch and switch, fixing `apps/covid`'s manual `component.cls` desync) |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `test/playwright/e2e/portal/ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` (`Examples with custom theme toggles (#21973)` covers dark-launch and light-launch first switches across all six examples plus `examples/dialog`'s default launch and open-editor sync) |

## Deltas from ticket
- Per `#21973#issuecomment-7084452770`, `#22003` (`ce343a2221`) already migrated `examples/dialog` onto `resolveStartTheme(Neo.config)` and `Neo.button.ThemeSwitcher`; source changes here cover the remaining five examples while `ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` verifies all six (including live open-editor theme propagation on `examples/dialog`).
- Declared `"themes": ["neo-theme-light", "neo-theme-dark"]` in `examples/calendar/basic/neo-config.json` so `?theme=neo-theme-neo-light` resolves to Calendar's classic `'neo-theme-light'` pair instead of `DefaultConfig.themes`'s `'neo-theme-neo-light'` entry, while preserving `'neo-theme-light'` on default launch.
- Initialized `Covid.view.mapboxGl.Component#mapboxStyle` from `this.getTheme()` in `onConstructed()`, applied `me.mapboxStyle` ahead of `me.data` in `MainContainerController#onHashChange` (`f3de1ff201`), and guarded lazy `mapboxglmap` / `worldmap` tabs in `MainContainerController#addStoreItems` (`if (activeTab)`, matching the `table`/`gallery`/`helix` branch, `b1ba1d8f4e`) so direct `#mainview=mapboxglmap` launches never race `fetch(apiUrl)` against lazy tab module import.

Frame critique: On `dev` (`3f01b65ae4`), `examples/calendar/basic?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark` opened in classic light (`#f2f2f2` header, `"THEME DARK"` button), `apps/covid?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark#mainview=mapboxglmap` booted `MapboxGL.create` on the generic initial `ck944yerq3hrj1ip91o34fa7d` style instead of `mapboxStyleDark` (`ck8yaxakx11zx1ilgshq451cv`, missing the country-border highlight layer), `apps/covid?theme=neo-theme-neo-light#mainview=mapboxglmap` stayed completely dark (`covid_logo_dark.jpg`, dark map, `"Theme Light"` button), and `examples/grid/bigData?theme=neo-theme-neo-light` opened dark with `Theme: Dark` checked. On `f3de1ff201`..`b1ba1d8f4e`, Calendar opens dark (`#33343d` header, `"Theme Light"` button), COVID opens with `covid_logo_dark.jpg` + `mapboxStyleDark` (including Germany's white border highlight) on dark launch and `covid_logo_light.jpg` + `mapboxStyleLight` + `"THEME DARK"` on light launch, and Big Data opens light with `Theme: Light` checked. Pre-existing traits in untouched files left as-is: (1) in `apps/covid/view/mapboxGl/Container.mjs` (`opacity: 0.6`, `backgroundColor: 'transparent'`), the floating `Map Controls` overlay lets faint underlying map city labels (`Petropavlovsk`, `Kokshetau`) show behind `HeatMap` / `Terrain`; (2) in `examples/calendar/basic`'s scrollable week grid, long 1-day event titles (`On-call hand…`, `Lunch & learn: web wo…`, `Customer interview: N…`) ellipsize to column width and `4 PM` events sit at the initial vertical scroll fold identically in both frames; (3) in `examples/grid/bigData`, the horizontal column scroller clips `Jul 20…` at the right edge before horizontal scrolling identically in both frames.

## Post-Merge Validation
- [ ] Verify on deployed `neomjs.com` after release/pages sync that launching Calendar, Dialog, COVID, Big Data, Tree Big Data, and Nested Record Fields from the Portal catalog in both Neo Dark and Neo Light opens in the matching scheme and switches on the first toggle action.

## Commits
- `19d10f01a7` — wire `resolveStartTheme`, reactive viewport-theme control sync across all 5 remaining examples, and 7-case Whitebox E2E coverage in `ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` (`#21973`)
- `f3de1ff201` — initialize `Covid.view.mapboxGl.Component#mapboxStyle` on construction, apply `me.mapboxStyle` ahead of `me.data` in `onHashChange`, and pin `mapboxStyle` in `ExamplesCatalogTheme.spec.mjs` (`#21973`)
- `b1ba1d8f4e` — guard lazy `mapboxglmap` / `worldmap` tabs in `MainContainerController#addStoreItems` before lazy module import settles (`#21973`)

**Class:** contained — the established #21953 start-theme pattern applied to five more examples, with e2e pins.
